param.type: "Number of loops converted to hardware loops"

briefdescription.para: Insert hardware loop intrinsics into loops which are deemed profitable by the target, by querying TargetTransformInfo.

detaileddescription.para: A hardware loop comprises of two intrinsics: one, outside the loop, to set the loop iteration count and another, in the exit block, to decrement the counter. The decremented value can either be carried through the loop via a phi or handled in some opaque way by the target.
